name: dsh-performance
description: Making DeepSeek Harness faster: tool concurrency and Cordis hot paths, measured end to end

scripts.bench: npm run prepare:sources && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings bench/run.ts --rounds 7 --out results/raw/run-latest.json && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings bench/summarize.ts && npm run report
scripts.bench:quick: npm run prepare:sources && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings bench/run.ts --rounds 1 --scale 0.02 --out results/raw/run-smoke.json && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings bench/summarize.ts --raw results/raw/run-smoke.json --out results/summary-smoke.json
